result.title: PGU-Decoder: Prior-Guided Unified Decoding for Industrial Road-Network Map Updating
result.comment: 11 pages. Accepted at KDD 2027, Applied Data Science (ADS) Track. This is the original submission version, prior to reviewer revisions
result.summary: Timely road-network map updates are essential to navigation and autonomous driving. Three key tasks are intra-intersection road network generation, merging/diverging detection, and drivable-area detection, covering topology, geometry, and attributes, respectively. Separate pipelines duplicate rule maintenance, quality assurance, and manual verification, increasing operational costs. We propose PGU-Decoder, a production-grade unified decoding framework for semantic prediction across these tasks. A Prior Query Module (PQM) constructs point-level prior queries from sampled locations on road-network geometries. Fixed reference points preserve positional priors throughout decoding, allowing the model to focus on surrounding context. Point-level representations are aggregated into instance-level representations, and a Relational Graph Attention Network (RGAT) captures inter-instance dependencies. Task-specific heads then generate predictions. We validate PGU-Decoder in large-scale automated road-network map updating across more than 360 cities in China, where it consistently outperforms seven baselines. Following deployment at AutoNavi Map, it achieves quality scores above 98% on all three tasks, reduces manual verification costs by 95%, and increases update frequency from weekly to hourly. These results demonstrate a practical and cost-effective industrial solution for road-network map updating.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PGU-Decoder 统一解码框架，用采样几何点构造点级先验查询并在解码中保持固定参考点，再将点级表示聚合为实例级并用 RGAT 建模实例间依赖，统一完成路口路网生成、分流/汇流检测与可行驶区域预测，并在中国 360 余城市与 AutoNavi 部署中验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「固定参考点在整个解码过程保留位置先验」与 RGAT 的实例关系建模，可能可供核查 LVR 中几何/空间证据在 latent 状态中的保持与实体关系编码，但论文面向路网地图更新而非 VLM 推理，无 latent 推理层面验证。
